title: The Anatomy of a Blockchain Prediction Market: Polymarket in the 2024 U.S. Presidential Election
abstract: arXiv:2603.03136v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Using the complete on-chain settlement ledger, we study Polymarket's 2024 U.S. presidential election markets, focusing on the Trump YES price widely quoted as a forecast of the race. Because the platform mints and burns outcome shares inside ordinary trades, naive aggregation overstates turnover. We develop a transaction-level decomposition that separates turnover from net inflow and market activity: in October it reports \$391 million of Trump-market turnover against \$958 million of naive volume. Corrected price impact reveals a shallower market: moving the October forecast by five percentage points cost \$9.1 million rather than \$15.6 million. Capital entered on both sides of the race throughout the month, consistent with heterogeneous beliefs rather than one-sided manipulation. The overstatement holds across 249 markets and is largest in thin, young ones.

translated_title: 区块链预测市场的剖析：2024年美国总统大选中的Polymarket
translated_abstract: 利用完整的链上结算账本，我们研究了Polymarket的2024年美国总统大选市场，重点关注被广泛引用为竞选预测指标的特朗普YES价格。由于该平台在普通交易中铸造和销毁结果份额，简单的聚合方法会高估交易额。我们开发了一种交易层面的分解方法，将真实交易额与净流入和市场活动区分开来：10月份该方法显示特朗普市场的真实交易额为3.91亿美元，而简单聚合的交易量则为9.58亿美元。修正后的价格冲击显示市场深度较浅：将10月份的预测值移动五个百分点需要910万美元，而非1560万美元。整个月内资金持续流入竞选双方，这与异质性信念相符，而非单边操纵。这种高估现象在249个市场中普遍存在，且在交易稀薄、较新的市场中最为显著。
tldr: 该研究利用Polymarket完整的链上结算账本，通过交易层面的分解方法发现，简单聚合方法显著高估了2024年美国大选预测市场的交易额（10月真实交易额为3.91亿美元而非9.58亿美元），市场深度也比之前估计的更浅，且资金双向流入表明市场反映的是异质性信念而非单边操纵。
en_tdlr: Using Polymarket's complete on-chain settlement ledger, this study develops a transaction-level decomposition showing that naive aggregation overstates 2024 U.S. election market turnover (actual October Trump-market turnover was $391 million vs. $958 million in naive volume), the market is shallower than previously estimated, and two-sided capital inflows indicate heterogeneous beliefs rather than one-sided manipulation.
